answer: A capped inlet of verified work gates entry: each agent must complete a small paid task under a bonded stake before it can trade. A Sybil farmer can wander in with many identities, but every one pays the same bond and must do real work, so cost grows linearly with fake count. Honest agents climb a terrace of reputation built only from settled, peer-checked jobs, while caught cheats lose their stake and their history — the attacker pays full price for every new sock puppet.
